people.name: Arabah
people.line: A desert region in the Jordan Valley and southward.

people.name: Goshen
people.line: A town and region in the hill country of Judah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same;
translations.bsb: So Joshua took this entire region: the hill country, all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel and their foothills,
